digest.component_or_area: rebar lifecycle policy enforcement and public-surface acceptance
propositions: Rebar project must enable both enforce_plan_material_pins and require_plan_review_for_close policies while library defaults remain false, with pre-feature unpinned attestations continuing to pass both gates.
Public lifecycle test suite must prove direct and natural-transitive invalidation only after actual narrow material changes, and unchanged successful re-review must produce no further propagation.
Outgoing depends_on and inbound blocks references must normalize to one canonical prerequisite pin and evaluation without eager backfill or graph-wide invalidation.

Execution adaptation, return-to-open reset, code-only close freshness, enable/disable/re-enable cycles, deleted/archived target handling, and concurrent review/close changes must be proven through public lifecycle surfaces.

Four real no-bypass CLI cases must verify legacy unpinned claims succeed, current pins with execution review close succeed, stale-pin-drift rejects with canonical target naming, and missing close-plan review rejects with remediation instruction.
No eager backfill, graph-wide invalidation event, new pin command, ordinary-list output change, or stored relation migration must be introduced.
